data.content_ref: inline:Strengthen the validity of committed roots by adding an irredundancy requirement: a root conjecture is committed only if deleting it and its incident attacks changes the grounded labeling of at least one other node; verify this with one additional fixed-point pass per root candidate. This is a property of the root set, not of the edge-construction layer, so it composes with any admissible enrichment (SRC_002, SRC_007) without altering the fixed-point operator. Criticizable points: it multiplies cost by the number of roots (breaking the spirit of the single-pass polynomial guarantee), and it presupposes a canonical definition of 'changes the labeling' that may itself depend on which enrichment was applied.
